# ISA Tech Marathon 2026

> A 3K and 5K run organized by the Indore Software Association (ISA), uniting
> 280+ IT companies in Indore for technology, fitness, and sustainability.
> Every 5km run plants a tree.

## Key facts

- Event: ISA Tech Marathon 2026
- Organizer: Indore Software Association (ISA)
- Main sponsor: NRC Group
- Date: 27th September 2026
- Start time: 6:30 AM IST
- Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India
- Distances: 3K Fun Run, 5K Challenge
- Green mission: every 5km run plants a tree ("3km = 1 tree")
- Registration: https://marathon.theisa.in/register
- Sponsorship enquiries: via the "Contact for Sponsorship" form on the homepage

## Pages

- Homepage: https://marathon.theisa.in/
- Register: https://marathon.theisa.in/register
- About: https://marathon.theisa.in/about
- Contact: https://marathon.theisa.in/contact
- Green Mission / tree counter: https://marathon.theisa.in/green

## Frequently asked questions

Q: When is the ISA Tech Marathon 2026?
A: 27th September 2026, starting at 6:30 AM IST, in Indore, Madhya Pradesh.

Q: What distances can I run?
A: A 3K Fun Run or a 5K Challenge.

Q: Who organizes the ISA Tech Marathon?
A: The Indore Software Association (ISA), with NRC Group as the main sponsor.

Q: How do I register?
A: Register online at https://marathon.theisa.in/register. Registration
requires name, email, phone, gender, category, and company (if applicable).

Q: What is the environmental impact?
A: The race supports a green mission — every 5km run plants a tree, with the
running total shown on the site's tree counter page.

Q: How can my company sponsor the event?
A: Use the "Contact for Sponsorship" form on the homepage to submit an
inquiry.
